text: Customers who already buy from an incumbent supplier carry switching risk. When the specification match is confirmed and the customer cites delivery problems with the incumbent, lowering the perceived risk of first use matters more than further technical argument.

Discounts beyond the account manager's authority need approval from sales management. Late-stage deals where price is the only open objection are decided by commercial terms, not by further product evidence.
Hazardous-area applications require certification such as ATEX or IECEx. A product without the required certification cannot be sold into that application, regardless of price or lead time.
Pressure sensor series P: accuracy class 0.5, CE marked, standard lead time 4 weeks, IP67, operating range minus 20 to 85 degrees Celsius. No hazardous-area certification.
Budget, decision authority and purchase timing should be established early. A contact without purchasing authority cannot commit the customer, whatever urgency they express.
